title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: A student finished bandsaw training on Monday and chats with your assistant. On Friday they open a new session. Your program saves nothing and sends only the system prompt and tool descriptions. What can the model use about Monday?

options.text: Nothing, because the Monday chat is not in the text it receives
A summary, because the model keeps a private memory of each user
The whole chat, because the model stores every conversation it had
The training fact, because training updates the model within a day

items.stem: Each model call rereads the whole transcript. The system prompt, tool descriptions and question total 1,000 tokens. Call 1 requests a tool whose result adds 500 tokens. Call 2 requests another tool whose result adds 500 tokens. Call 3 writes the final answer. Ignoring the tokens the model writes, how many input tokens are read across the three calls in total?
Your 400-page laser cutter manual is far too long to place in every context. Which design answers manual questions at the lowest cost per request while still finding the right page?

options.text: Index chunks of the manual and have a tool return the best few matches
Paste the whole manual into the system prompt so it is always available
Save the whole manual as a note and load it at the start of each session
Ask the model to recall the manual from its training and skip any lookup

items.stem: In one sentence, what is the difference between the context window and the notes an agent saves between sessions?
Your assistant answers a question about 'kerf' but fails when a student asks about 'the width of the cut', though the manual only uses 'kerf'. Which statement best explains this and its fix?

options.text: Keyword search missed the different wording; add meaning-based search too
Meaning-based search missed the exact word; remove it and keep keywords
The context window was full; switch to a model with a larger window
The notes were stale; save the full chat transcript for each student
